description:
Manage email credential setup and runtime configuration.

Setup actions (credential lifecycle):
- status: Show current credential state, setup URL, and configured accounts
- setup_status: Show credential state and setup URL only (no accounts list; cross-server parity action)
- setup_start (-> force): Trigger relay setup session and return the setup URL. Set force=true to restart even if already in progress
- setup_reset: Clear all saved credentials and reset to awaiting_setup state
- setup_complete: Re-check credential state after external config changes (e.g. relay submission)

Runtime actions:
- set: Update runtime settings (email has no runtime settings; returns ok=false)
- cache_clear: Clear in-memory account and OAuth token caches

force.description: Force restart relay setup even if already in progress (for setup_start action)

name: config
